messages.text:
Your cancelled card does not stop the refund. The shop sends refunds only to the original payment, and the card issuer handles any credit; the shop can’t promise where or when it will appear (refund-policy/v2/payment; refund-policy/v2/payout).

I’ve proposed **BRL 55.00** for the rug. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card. A chat reply won’t confirm it. The refund still needs staff approval before it can be paid (refund-policy/v2/approval).
